before_times: for you, or for someone you help (adults only: 18 and over)
new or returning patient (a new patient gets the 60-minute new patient evaluation)
which visit: the clinic's own visit types only, never a symptom typed into the AI
a car accident or a work injury (then it's billed to that claim)
a health plan (its name only), Medicare, or paying yourself
after_time: anything that helps at the visit, like the step-free door or an interpreter
at home: who will be there, where to park, and a clear space for the doctor
secure_page_only: plan member ID and a photo of the insurance card
for a car accident or a work injury: the claim number and the adjuster
health history: the reason, past care, medicines, allergies, and pregnancy
consent to care, after the doctor's main risks are explained, and the privacy notice
for a procedure: the name of the person who will drive home
intake_questions.never_asked: symptoms, the reason for the visit and results are never asked or typed in the AI chat; words typed there are checked for danger, then not kept
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a guardian or health care agent for an adult who can't consent (papers on file). No visit is booked for anyone under 18: the clinic refers a minor to a pediatric clinic

stop.words: chest pain, trouble breathing, a sudden very bad headache, or sudden weakness, numbness, a drooping face or slurred speech
stop.say: This needs help now. Call 911. Don't wait for a clinic visit.

stop.words: a fever, chills, or a hot, swollen or leaking place after a procedure or an injection; numbness in the groin or inner thighs; new trouble controlling the bladder or bowels; or leg weakness that's getting worse
stop.say: This needs a doctor now. Go to an emergency room, or call 911. Don't wait for a clinic visit.
stop.booking: no booking; the same words texted before a visit get the same message, the owner is told and calls, and the visit stays unless the patient cancels, with no fee

stop.words: taking too much medicine or an overdose, or thoughts of ending a life
stop.say: Call 911 now. For thoughts of self-harm you can also call or text 988, any time.
stop.booking: no booking; the owner is told at once and calls

go_on.words: a planned follow-up, a medication check, or a check-in on a plan of care
go_on.what: books as usual; Rosie only matches words and never judges how serious anything is

safety_and_stop_words.always: the general screen: danger to life, fire, gas or a medical emergency gets 911, and words about self-harm get 988

steps.name: Health history and consent
steps.when: on the secure page only, never by text; due the day before the visit (a same-day visit: before the time is held); one reminder before it's due
steps.who: every new patient; returning patients once a year, or when their health changes
steps.result: the consent is signed after the doctor explains the main risks, before any procedure; not done by its due date: Sam keeps the visit (signed on the secure page at the desk first), moves it, or cancels with no fee

steps.name: The plan check
steps.when: while booking, by the front desk, by hand
steps.who: every patient who names a plan
steps.result: covered (the copay, visits left), some services only, not covered, or can't check now (the desk checks later, and the patient may cancel free)

steps.name: The approval for a procedure
steps.when: before the procedure day, where the plan asks for one
steps.who: every patient booked for a procedure visit
steps.result: approved: the procedure stays; not approved: no procedure is booked, and the visit stays at the self-pay price or the patient may cancel free

steps.name: The claim for a car accident or a work injury
steps.when: on the secure page while booking; the desk confirms it before the visit
steps.who: every patient whose visit is billed to a claim
steps.result: no claim confirmed: the visit stays at the self-pay price, or a free cancel

steps.name: A written price estimate for self-pay patients
steps.when: told while booking; sent within 1 business day, or sooner where the rules require it
steps.result: a to-do for the front desk, with its due date

steps.name: A re-exam before more procedures
steps.who: a returning patient with no exam in the last 12 months
steps.result: the doctor goes on, suggests another plan, or refers the patient to another doctor

first_steps_and_forms.prep: arrive 15 minutes early; bring a photo ID, the insurance card, a list of current medicines, and any past scans; for a procedure day, arrange a ride home (the desk confirms it on the secure page)

staff.skills: doctors: exams, plans of care, medication checks and procedures in the procedure room; the front desk: check-in, plan checks, approvals, estimates and payment; only people cleared for home visits go to homes
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each doctor's own state medical license, as the owner gives it
staff.supervision: a medical assistant works only while a doctor is in the building, as the clinic's own rule
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs same-day visits, any price made for one patient (for a procedure, every one), and anything a doctor flags
staff.stand_in: a doctor out: another doctor takes their patients where there's room, and the patient chooses; the patient never hears why someone is out

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a guardian or health care agent for an adult who can't consent (papers on file). No visit is booked for anyone under 18: the clinic refers a minor to a pediatric clinic
children_and_age.minors_texts: no visits for anyone under 18 (the clinic refers a minor to a pediatric clinic), so no minor's text is sent
children_and_age.minors_rules: no visits for anyone under 18 at this clinic

visit.check_in: at the clinic: the check-in code at the front desk, with a photo ID; at home: the code at the door
visit.done: the check-in code or DONE; notes, scans and medicine records stay in the clinic's own records, shared with the patient only in person, never in Rosie or a text
visit.changes_at_visit: a scan only if the doctor orders it, with the price shown first and the patient's yes; a procedure only on the doctor's own order, after the consent, and with the plan's approval where the plan asks; something that needs another doctor first means no procedure, the visit is paid, and notes go to the doctor the patient names; a plan of care is suggested in person, stays on the secure page, and is never pushed
visit.before_work: the doctor reads the health history, takes the history and examines before any procedure, with their own danger checks

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: each doctor the owner names holds their own state medical license; the clinic where the state's form asks
license.who: each person; the clinic too where the state's form asks for it
license.ask: the owner gives each license number in plain words, by text or on the secure page; Rosie keeps it as the owner's own word
license.insurance: malpractice insurance only as the owner's own word, if the owner adds it

never_in_a_text: texts carry only the clinic's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the visit type, the plan, the reason, the medicines, procedures, results or the doctor's name (at home, the doctor's name stays, for the door check)
